name: Bubble Gum Clicker 🫧
desc:
Welcome to Bubble Gum Clicker!

Gain bubbles with every click! 🚀
Blow your bubble gum to make it bigger and jump higher! 🫧
Complete towers to increase the amount of bubbles you get with every click and earn wins! 🏆
Collect pets! 🐶
Unlock new worlds! 🌎

Roblox Premium Benefits: +50% Bubbles and Daily Premium Rewards! 💎

Join "lol games.." to unlock daily group rewards and +10% Bubbles! https://www.roblox.com/groups/12208023/lol-games 🎁

Invite friends for a bubble boost! 👥

If you enjoy this game leave a like and favorite! 👍
